integrity_note: Analytic theorem with explicit source comparisons and a standalone finite diagnostic checker; finite checks are not an infinite proof. Unconditional free-mean optimum is credited as prior; independent scientific assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary two-level Hamiltonian, orthogonal preparation/detection rays, nonzero transition coupling, ideal rank-one projective measurement, iid strictly positive intervals and fixed known mean; no lower gap, cost, feedback, noise or estimation guarantee. The low-mean value is an unattained infimum in the positive-interval class.
title: Fixed-mean renewal probing has three sharp optimal phases in a two-level quantum detector
